title: Clouda PDF
description:
Clouda PDF is an Arabic-first, model-agnostic PDF-to-DOCX runtime with isolated data, training, and model subsystems, aimed at open, self-hostable, independently evaluated Arabic Document AI infrastructure. It converts trusted born-digital PDF text into editable DOCX files for Arabic, English, and mixed-language documents while preserving page order, Arabic Unicode, right-to-left paragraph direction, footers, and page boundaries.

Pages are classified through a canonical digital-text trust gate and explicit routing states, including digital_text, blank_page, near_blank, pending_ocr_model, and review_required. Scanned, image-only, or uncertain pages are routed to explicit review states instead of being presented as OCR output. The repository also includes deterministic synthetic Arabic OCR data generation, pre-training dataset preparation, training planning, and a published metadata-only Arabic OCR benchmark. No final trained OCR model is bundled and OCR inference remains disabled by default.
